name: SDT Pack Sitter (experimental)
description: Warm native Zotero SDT packs, one attachment at a time; a disposable on-disk cache carries pack-freshness and duration observations across sessions, never an active-job or failure ledger. A failed document is suppressed for the session and asked again on the next activation. Indexing is asked about once, then held by a persisted on/off switch in the add-on's own window, which stops admissions and lets the file under way finish. State transitions go to Zotero's debug output and a volatile in-session ring.
